answer.reason: Ai is the scene of Israel's defeat and then its capture and burning, which are events of the place itself.

clauses.english: routed about three thousand Israelites and killed thirty-six of them
clauses.quote: the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men

clauses.english: was taken by an Israelite ambush, its people slain, and burned into a heap for ever
clauses.quote: Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever

doubts: GEN 12:8 and GEN 13:3 give Hai only as a landmark for Abram's tent and altar, so they were left out.
EZR 2:28 and NEH 7:32 only count the men of Bethel and Ai, so they were left out.
